Incident Report – Delivery / Order Return

Order: #88501-1846
Store: Co-op – Creekmoor
Customer: Phil Daynes
Address: Flat 11, 89 Petersham Road, BH17 7DW

I collected the order from Co-op – Creekmoor, receiving 1 sealed bag, and travelled to the customer’s address to complete the delivery.

Upon arrival, as this order contained age-restricted items, I requested and checked the customer’s ID. The date of birth provided was 30/05/1953, however when entering the details into the app, the age verification failed twice, preventing me from completing the delivery.

During this process, the customer’s wife returned with the bag and stated that 2 pizzas were missing from the order. I explained that I am not authorised to open sealed bags or check the contents inside, and advised her to contact support regarding the missing items.

After I explained this, the customer’s wife handed the bag back to me and closed the door.

I also attempted to report and explain the situation through the Just chat, but the chat froze and became unavailable, preventing me from explaining the situation through the app. In addition, my app remained stuck on this order, not allowing me to proceed or complete the delivery process normally.

Due to the failed age verification, the complaint about missing items, and the app issue, I returned to Co-op – Creekmoor, explained the situation to the store, and completed the return of the bag/order. I would also appreciate it if this app issue could be resolved, as the application remains frozen on the same customer/order and I am currently unable to continue working or proceed with new deliveries.

question: Q3
response_original:
I want to share my honest experience working with your platform, as there are serious issues that need addressing:

1. Order collection delays: When arriving to pick up orders, the food is often not ready. We face very long waiting times, which wastes time and stops us from completing more deliveries.

2. Poor restaurant service: Many restaurant staff do not prioritize Just Eat orders or respect riders. Their attitude and behavior toward us are unprofessional and uncaring.

3. Unfair and low pay: The rates paid per delivery are extremely low. They do not cover fuel, vehicle costs, or our time and effort — the work is simply not worth doing.

4. Unreasonable rating system: Rejecting even one order causes an immediate 10% drop in our rating. Even after completing 10 or more successful orders later, the rating never recovers. If we have to wait 20–30 minutes and decide to cancel, our rating gets deducted — but this is never our fault, it is an issue from Just Eat or the restaurant, yet we are punished for it.

5. Useless live support: Trying to contact your support team is a waste of time. We wait 20 to 30 minutes with no reply, and when we finally hear back, it is only a generic apology. An apology means nothing when we have already lost time and money on a £3 order. The support system is completely unreliable and shows no care for riders.

Overall, the app, pay, support, and rules are getting worse day by day. If these problems are not fixed, it will become impossible to keep working for Just Eat.

response_original:
I am very disappointed with how this delivery has been handled.
I accepted two orders: the first contained age-restricted items from Co-op, and the second was a food delivery.
When I arrived at the first customer's address, the customer initially told me they had not ordered anything. As I was walking back to my car, they remembered it was the Co-op order. I then asked for their ID, and they provided their passport. The name on the passport matched the name on the app.
However, when I entered the customer's date of birth, the app rejected it twice. After the second attempt, the app instructed me to return the order to the store. I followed the instructions and made a second trip back to the shop to return the items.
Support then cancelled the order. Because of this, I had to make three journeys in total—driving to the customer, back to the store, and then continuing with my second delivery. Despite following the correct procedure and not cancelling the order myself, my payment was reduced from around £7 to only £0.87.
I do not understand why I am being penalised for something that was outside my control. I followed the app's instructions and complied with the age verification process. I would appreciate a review of this case and payment for the additional time and distance I travelled.

response_original:
Dear Just Eat Management Team,
I hope you are doing well.
I would like to raise a concern regarding the drink packaging used by McDonald's for orders delivered through Just Eat.
The current packaging for soft drinks, which consists of paper cups with plastic lids, appears to have a recurring leakage problem. In my experience, around 95% of McDonald's orders containing drinks have some level of leakage. As a result, drinks often spill inside the delivery bag, damaging the rest of the order and creating an unpleasant experience for customers.
This issue also affects delivery drivers, who regularly receive complaints despite having no control over how the drinks are packaged. It is frustrating for both customers and drivers when orders arrive wet or damaged because of leaking cups.
I kindly ask that Just Eat discuss this issue with McDonald's and encourage them to improve or redesign their drink packaging so that it is more secure during delivery. Better packaging would help protect food, reduce waste, improve customer satisfaction, and make deliveries easier for drivers.
Thank you for taking the time to consider this feedback. I hope this issue can be addressed in partnership with McDonald's to improve the overall delivery experience.

question: Q3
response_original:
Dear Just Eat Support Team,

I would like to make a formal complaint regarding an issue I experienced while working as a delivery driver.

I am not entirely sure how the app operates from your end, but Just Eat advises drivers not to accept or pick up orders if they are unable to complete them. Unfortunately, the app does not seem to take circumstances beyond a driver’s control into account.

On Monday, I was assigned an order from Asda in East Boldon. When I arrived, the staff member responsible for assisting drivers informed me that the order would take over an hour to prepare because they were extremely busy. I was advised to cancel the order rather than wait.

After cancelling and leaving, the app repeatedly offered me the same order. I declined it multiple times, yet my acceptance rate continued to decrease. This feels very unfair, particularly when the cancellation was not due to any fault of my own.

Drivers work long hours in all weather conditions and face risks on the road to earn a living. Penalising drivers for circumstances outside their control is discouraging and, in situations like this, feels unreasonable. Had I not turned off the app, my acceptance rate would likely have dropped significantly simply because I refused to return to an order that the store itself had advised me to cancel.

I would like to know who is responsible for the design and management of the app’s order allocation system, as I believe there needs to be a better process for handling situations where restaurants or stores are unable to fulfil orders promptly.

I have recommended Just Eat to many people and would like to see the platform treat its drivers fairly. Drivers are human beings with families and responsibilities. I am a single mother who is working hard to support my family while studying to become a nurse, and I know many other drivers are in similar situations.

I hope my complaint will be taken seriously and that it contributes to improvements in how these issues are handled in the future.

Thank you for taking the time to read my concerns. I look forward to your response.

Kind regards,

Nkechi

response_original:
Hi Just Eat Support, I would also like to raise a concern about the current delivery fees paid to couriers.

The payment for many deliveries is quite low compared with the actual costs involved in completing them. As drivers, we have to cover fuel, vehicle maintenance, servicing, tyres, insurance and general wear and tear on our cars. When we also have to spend a long time waiting at restaurants or stores for orders to be prepared, the amount we earn for that delivery can become very low for the total time and expenses involved.

I would kindly request that Just Eat review the current courier payment rates and consider increasing the delivery fees to better reflect the distance travelled, waiting time and the rising costs of operating a vehicle.

A fairer payment system would make a significant difference for couriers who are using their own vehicles and covering all these expenses themselves.

Thank you for taking this feedback into consideration.

However, I believe there are some things that could be improved in the app. For example, if a driver has a problem during a delivery, such as a flat bike tyre, perhaps the app could offer the option to transfer the order to another nearby driver who is available.
This way, the customer would still receive the order, and the driver who had the problem would not be penalised or charged for something that was completely out of their control.
I was willing to complete the delivery, even if it meant taking a little longer because I needed time to fix my bike. Unfortunately, the order was closed instead.
This is just a suggestion that I hope you can consider in the future, as it could help both customers and drivers. Thank you for listening.

Subject: Repeated long waiting times at Morrisons

Hi, I would like to report an ongoing issue with orders from Morrisons.

Almost every time I accept an order from this store, I arrive on time but then have to wait around 30 minutes for the order to be prepared and handed over. There is currently only one person picking the orders, which causes significant delays.

These orders are often around £5, so waiting 30 minutes just to collect one order makes them extremely inefficient for couriers. It also means I lose the opportunity to accept other orders during that time.

Could you please look into this with Morrisons and see if something can be done to improve the preparation/collection process? The waiting time is becoming a regular problem, not an isolated incident.

Thank you.

Almost every time I accept an order from this store, I arrive on time but then have to wait around 30 minutes for the order to be prepared and handed over. There is currently only one person picking the orders, which causes significant delays.

These orders are often around £5, so waiting 30 minutes just to collect one order makes them extremely inefficient for couriers. It also means I lose the opportunity to accept other orders during that time.

Could you please look into this with Morrisons and see if something can be done to improve the preparation/collection process? The waiting time is becoming a regular problem, not an isolated incident.

Thank you.

response_original:
Hi Support Team,

I am raising a formal complaint regarding how my previous support case was handled.

I attended KFC to collect an assigned order, but the restaurant refused to hand over the food because staff claimed they had not witnessed me confirming collection on the app.

Although your agent eventually removed the KFC order, I was subsequently informed that this would affect my acceptance rate, delivery pay and potentially my account standing.

I strongly dispute the classification of this incident as a voluntary order cancellation.

I did not abandon the delivery. I attended the restaurant and was ready to complete the collection. The restaurant’s refusal to release the food was entirely outside my control.

I am therefore requesting:

1. A review and correction of the reason recorded for removing the KFC order.
2. Written confirmation that this incident will not negatively affect my account standing or delivery performance.
3. A review of compensation for my wasted journey, time and associated vehicle expenses.
4. An explanation of why the previous support ticket was closed without addressing my compensation request.

Please escalate this matter to the appropriate team if necessary.

I would appreciate a substantive response rather than a generic explanation of the consequences of cancelling orders.

Thank you.
